features.quote: max_turns = 24 default, with stop conditions {solved, model_gave_up, model_stopped, max_turns}
features.justification_quote: long enough for the spiral to develop ... but capped to bound cost

features.quote: a `give_up` tool exists and terminating via it is recorded distinctly
features.justification_quote: Forcing it to keep going until `max_turns` would manufacture degradation that wouldn't occur if the model had an honorable way to stop

features.quote: stop_on_no_tool_calls` defaults to true (a no-tool assistant turn ends the episode)
features.justification_quote: an agent that stops calling tools has effectively halted; continuing to prompt it would distort behavior
